mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE >0.2pp rise months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declines, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0) signals easing supply chain constraints that reduce input costs and boost corporate margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO >105.0 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL rise >0.5pp monthly) signals imminent monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL >0.5pp rise months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior three months indicates labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (UNRATE) and federal funds rate declines (FEDFUNDS) signal policy response to labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of UNRATE rise + FEDFUNDS decline periods, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year) signals aggressive monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL >3.0% year-over-year periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 5-year rolling window.
